meta.title: Deep Search Challenge
meta.tagline: An interactive AI agent workflow simulation

roles.name: Planner Agent
roles.description: The strategist of the swarm. Turns a vague human question into an executable research strategy.
roles.goal: Break the research problem into a logical search strategy.
roles.mission: Select the steps that form the strongest possible search plan.
roles.quote: I don't Google. I Google what should be Googled.
funMessages: Refusing to search until the plan is beautiful.

roles.name: Searcher Agent
roles.description: The field operative. Executes the plan across the open web and pulls back raw sources.
roles.goal: Retrieve the highest quality sources that satisfy the plan.
roles.mission: Pick the sources a serious researcher would actually open.
roles.quote: Searching the internet... definitely not opening Reddit first.
funMessages: Page 2 of the results exists. I checked.
Ignoring the sponsored links like a professional.

roles.name: Validator Agent
roles.description: The skeptic. Assumes every source is guilty of being wrong until proven otherwise.
roles.goal: Filter the collected sources down to what can actually be trusted.
roles.mission: Apply the validation checks that matter for this question.
funMessages: This blog post is not a peer-reviewed journal.
Checking the date. Always checking the date.

roles.name: Reporter Agent
roles.description: The closer. Assembles validated evidence into something a human will actually read.
roles.goal: Structure the findings into a clear, defensible report.
roles.mission: Choose the right sections and put them in the right order.
funMessages: Adding a chart nobody asked for.

researchRequests.question: Was the refereeing unfair in the Egypt vs Argentina match?
researchRequests.context: A contested result has split social media. Determine what actually happened on the pitch.

researchRequests.question: Is the Earth round or flat?
researchRequests.context: A settled scientific question that still generates noise online.

researchRequests.question: Who is Elon Musk and what is he currently responsible for?
researchRequests.context: Build an accurate, current profile of a public figure.

researchRequests.question: What is Elsewedy Electric and what does the company actually do?
researchRequests.context: Corporate research brief for a new joiner.

researchRequests.question: Should electric vehicles fully replace gasoline cars?
researchRequests.context: A policy debate with strong lobbying on both sides.

researchRequests.question: What caused the Titanic to sink?
researchRequests.context: A historical investigation with official inquiry records available.

researchRequests.question: Is climate change caused by human activity?
researchRequests.context: Separate scientific consensus from manufactured controversy.

researchRequests.question: How does DeepSeek compare to ChatGPT?
researchRequests.context: Technical model comparison for an engineering team.

researchRequests.question: What are the latest obligations under the EU AI Act?
researchRequests.context: Compliance research. The legal text is the ground truth.

researchRequests.question: Should companies adopt a four-day workweek?
researchRequests.context: HR strategy question backed by real pilot programmes.

researchRequests.question: Does remote work increase or decrease productivity?
researchRequests.context: Contradictory studies exist. Methodology decides the answer.

researchRequests.question: Are mRNA vaccines safe for healthy adults?
researchRequests.context: High-stakes health question. Only clinical evidence counts.

researchRequests.question: Is cryptocurrency trading legal in Egypt?
researchRequests.context: Jurisdiction-specific legal status. Regulations change.

researchRequests.question: What is the current status of the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam negotiations?
researchRequests.context: A live geopolitical file with three governments telling different stories.

researchRequests.question: Is drinking coffee daily good or bad for your health?
researchRequests.context: Nutrition science: every headline says the opposite of the last one.

researchRequests.question: Will AI eliminate more jobs than it creates?
researchRequests.context: Economic forecasting question. Predictions are not evidence.

researchRequests.question: Which programming language should a new backend team standardise on?
researchRequests.context: An engineering decision, not a religious war.

researchRequests.question: Is a permanent human colony on Mars feasible this century?
researchRequests.context: Distinguish engineering reality from marketing timelines.

researchRequests.question: Does social media harm teenage mental health?
researchRequests.context: Correlation is everywhere. Causation is the hard part.

researchRequests.question: Is green hydrogen commercially viable for heavy industry?
researchRequests.context: Energy transition business case. Follow the cost curves.
